basis: The full-period reservoir storage change from 2005 to 2014 is 13.8 points (23.9 - 10.1). The routing decision requires determining if this change meets the 'substantial-change' criterion. The task and chart provide no numeric threshold for what constitutes a substantial change. The option to route to substantial-change follow-up is conditional on meeting an unstated criterion, which is not provided. Therefore, no option is justified under the task constraints, as the decision cannot be made without a defined substantial-change threshold.
